name: copy-button
title: Copy Button
description: An icon button that copies a value, such as a reply, or an image (CopyData: a type and its blob, asked for on the press; several in an array are one copy, e.g. a table as text/html and text/plain): its name and tooltip say "Copied" for a while after (pressed, the tooltip stays open to say so), and screen readers hear it. A value that has changed since (e.g. streaming) is not claimed as copied; when the clipboard refuses, it says it could not copy. With `showLabel`, its word beside the icon ("Copy", then "Copied"), as wide as the wider of them so it does not jump, and no tooltip.
